faults.why: Northern Vietnamese 'tr' is pronounced /t͡ɕ/ or /c/, and the vowel in 'trưa' is /ɨə/, not /uə/.

faults.quote: Often shortened to just 'trưa' in casual conversation among friends
faults.why: False claim; people say the verb phrase 'ăn trưa' (eat lunch), not 'trưa' alone for the meal.
